message.content:
Below is a quick‑start guide for a few popular public APIs that accept an IP address and return company‑level data (name, domain, phone, email, etc.) when available.  
All of them offer a free tier, but the limits differ, so pick the one that best matches your expected traffic.

| Service | Free Tier | Key Features | Example Endpoint | Sample Response |
|---------|-----------|--------------|------------------|-----------------|
| **ipinfo.io** | 50 000 requests/month | Company name, domain, phone, email, logo, industry, size, etc. | `https://ipinfo.io/<IP>/json?token=<TOKEN>` | ```json{ "company": {"name":"Acme Corp","domain":"acme.com","phone":"+1-555-123-4567","email":"contact@acme.com","logo":"https://acme.com/logo.png","industry":"Manufacturing","size":"51-200"} }``` |
| **ipapi.co** | 1 000 requests/day | Company name, domain, phone, email, logo, industry, size, etc. | `https://ipapi.co/<IP>/json/?key=<KEY>` | ```json{ "company_name":"Acme Corp","company_domain":"acme.com","company_phone":"+1-555-123-4567","company_email":"contact@acme.com","company_logo":"https://acme.com/logo.png","company_industry":"Manufacturing","company_size":"51-200"} ``` |
| **ipstack.com** | 10 000 requests/month | Company name, domain, phone, email, logo, industry, size, etc. | `https://api.ipstack.com/<IP>?access_key=<KEY>&fields=company` | ```json{ "company": {"name":"Acme Corp","domain":"acme.com","phone":"+1-555-123-4567","email":"contact@acme.com","logo":"https://acme.com/logo.png","industry":"Manufacturing","size":"51-200"} }``` |
| **ipgeolocation.io** | 1 000 requests/day | Company name, domain, phone, email, logo, industry, size, etc. | `https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=<KEY>&ip=<IP>&fields=company` | ```json{ "company": {"name":"Acme Corp","domain":"acme.com","phone":"+1-555-123-4567","email":"contact@acme.com","logo":"https://acme.com/logo.png","industry":"Manufacturing","size":"51-200"} }``` |
| **ipdata.co** | 1 000 requests/day | Company name, domain, phone, email, logo, industry, size, etc. | `https://api.ipdata.co/<IP>?api-key=<KEY>&fields=company` | ```json{ "company": {"name":"Acme Corp","domain":"acme.com","phone":"+1-555-123-4567","email":"contact@acme.com","logo":"https://acme.com/logo.png","industry":"Manufacturing","size":"51-200"} }``` |

> **Tip:** All of these services return the same set of fields under a `company` object.  
> If you only need the company name, you can filter the fields in the request (e.g., `fields=company.name`).

---

## How to Use One of These APIs

Below is a minimal example using **ipinfo.io** in Python. Replace `<TOKEN>` with your personal access token.

```python
import requests

def get_company_info(ip_address: str, token: str):
    url = f"https://ipinfo.io/{ip_address}/json"
    params = {"token": token}
    resp = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=5)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()

    # ipinfo.io nests company data under the "company" key
    company = data.get("company", {})
    return {
        "name": company.get("name"),
        "domain": company.get("domain"),
        "phone": company.get("phone"),
        "email": company.get("email"),
        "logo": company.get("logo"),
        "industry": company.get("industry"),
        "size": company.get("size")
    }

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    ip = "8.8.8.8"
    token = "YOUR_IPINFO_TOKEN"
    info = get_company_info(ip, token)
    print(info)
```

### Using `requests_get` (Python function)

If you prefer to use the `requests_get` tool defined in the prompt, here’s how you’d call it:

```json
{
  "url": "https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/json",
  "params": {
    "token": "YOUR_IPINFO_TOKEN"
  },
  "timeout": 5
}
```

The tool will return the raw JSON response, which you can then parse as shown above.

---

## Choosing the Right Service

| Criteria | ipinfo.io | ipapi.co | ipstack.com | ipgeolocation.io | ipdata.co |
|----------|-----------|----------|-------------|------------------|-----------|
| **Free requests** | 50 k/mo | 1 k/day | 10 k/mo | 1 k/day | 1 k/day |
| **Company fields** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Ease of use** | Very simple | Very simple | Simple | Simple | Simple |
| **Rate limiting** | 1 k/min | 1 k/min | 1 k/min | 1 k/min | 1 k/min |
| **Pricing (paid)** | $50/mo for 500 k/mo | $50/mo for 100 k/mo | $50/mo for 500 k/mo | $50/mo for 100 k/mo | $50/mo for 100 k/mo |

If you’re just experimenting or have low traffic, **ipinfo.io** is a great starting point because of its generous free tier and straightforward API. For higher volume or more advanced features (e.g., additional fields like company logo or industry classification), consider upgrading to a paid plan or switching to another provider.

---

### Final Thoughts

- **Authentication**: All services require an API key or token. Sign up on their websites to obtain one.
- **Privacy**: Some IP addresses may not map to a company (e.g., residential IPs). In those cases, the `company` field will be empty or omitted.
- **Caching**: If you’re making repeated requests for the same IP, cache the result locally to stay within rate limits.

Happy coding! If you need help integrating any of these into a specific framework (Node.js, Go, etc.), let me know.
